title: QIF v0.6.2 Audience Explanation Contract
description: Harden authoring-template packages so generated QIF artifacts must be explained with general-public wording, simple diagrams, step-by-step questions, and comprehension checks.
validated_need: QIF adoption fails if only experts can understand QIF outputs. Structural validity must be paired with an explicit explanation contract for non-expert users.
intent: Make understandability a verifier-visible authoring requirement without claiming that verifier success proves user comprehension.
context: v0.6.1 already defines authoring templates. This slice adds audience explanation contracts instead of creating a separate communication framework.
triage_note: Implementation completed; release outcome will be recorded in docs/aof-runtime-log.md if released.
